tasks.label: Build active C/C++ file
args: $file = "${file}"; $dir = Split-Path -Parent $file; $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($file); $ext = [IO.Path]::GetExtension($file).ToLowerInvariant(); $compiler = if ($ext -eq '.c') { 'gcc.exe' } elseif ($ext -eq '.cpp') { 'g++.exe' } else { Write-Error 'Open a .c or .cpp file first'; exit 1 }; & $compiler $file -Wall -Wextra -g -o (Join-Path $dir "$name.exe"); exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Run active C/C++ file
args: $file = "${file}"; $dir = Split-Path -Parent $file; $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($file); $exe = Join-Path $dir "$name.exe"; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)) { Write-Error 'Build the active file first with Ctrl+Shift+B'; exit 1 }; & $exe
